home.title: Imagine how you want to live.
home.description: Every room can tell a different story. Make room for your ideas.
home.planCaption: A great space starts with an idea.
home.emptyDescription: You have no saved projects yet.
home.localNote: Your space is yours. No account, no connection.
home.footer: Made for thinking in metres. And in possibilities.

wizard.title: Give your idea a name.
wizard.description: Name your project and choose a rectangle, an L-shaped room or two connected spaces.
wizard.measureDescription: Enter the interior measurements in metres or centimetres; connected spaces share the same height.
wizard.range: Each measurement must be between {{min}} and {{max}} {{unit}}. A decimal comma or point is accepted.
wizard.previewPending: Check the measurements to preview the layout.
wizard.previewCaption: A proportional preview of your room.

errors.cutout: The cutout must leave at least {{min}} {{unit}} in each arm of the L.

storage.listError: We could not read projects on this device. Try loading them again.
storage.unreadable: Some projects could not be opened. They have been kept unchanged on this device.
storage.openError: We could not open this project. Its saved data has not been changed. You can try again.
storage.saveError: Could not save on this device. Your entries are still in the form; check the available storage and try again.

room.planCaption: A proportional plan of the room you created.
room.summaryNote: This summary shows your room’s dimensions. You can reopen it from your projects.
room.noRoom: This project has no rooms yet.

editor.help: Drag to pan. Pinch or use the wheel to zoom. Tap a room to select it.
editor.keyboard: With the plan focused, use arrows to pan, plus or minus to zoom, 0 to fit, Enter to select and Escape to clear the selection.
editor.noSelection: Select a room to see its dimensions.

openings.title: Doors and windows
openings.empty: This project has no doors or windows yet.
openings.wallMap: Selected wall in orange, with its start marked zero and the measurement direction shown by the arrow
openings.formHelp: Choose the wall and enter the measurements. Confirm to save the change.
openings.positionHelp: Distance is measured from the zero marked on the wall. A decimal comma or point is accepted.
openings.selectedInfo: Start: {{offset}} m · Height above floor: {{sill}} m.

errors.choose: Choose a valid room and wall.
errors.positive: Enter a measurement greater than zero, up to 10,000 m.
errors.nonNegative: Enter a measurement of zero or more, up to 10,000 m.
errors.wallFit: The width and starting distance must fit within the wall.
errors.heightFit: The height above floor plus opening height must fit within the room.
errors.overlap: This opening overlaps another on the same wall. Change its position or dimensions.
errors.limit: This project has reached its limit of 256 openings.
errors.notFound: This opening no longer exists. Cancel and reopen the project.
errors.invalid: Could not validate the opening. Check its dimensions and wall.
errors.connection: That span is the open passage between spaces. Choose an exterior wall or change the position and width.

saveErrors.failed: Could not save the change. The previous project is still intact. Try again.
saveErrors.conflict: The project changed in another screen. Reopen it from your projects before saving.
saveErrors.missing: This project is no longer saved on the device. Go back to your projects.
saveErrors.unreadable: Could not read the saved copy. It has been kept without replacing it.

finishes.title: Finishes
finishes.help: Choose the surface and a finish or color. Save to apply it to the plan. Switching surfaces loads their saved finish.
finishes.allHelp: The same finish will be applied to every wall in this room.
finishes.mixed: These walls have different finishes. Saving will apply the chosen finish to all of them.
finishes.colorHelp: Use # and six hexadecimal characters, for example #03038C.
finishes.colorError: Enter a six-character HEX color, for example #03038C.
finishes.unknownHelp: The saved pattern is not in this library. Its color is shown and the pattern is kept when saving; choose another to replace it.
finishes.libraryHelp: Generic samples included in the app. Floor patterns are schematic.

furniture.title: Furniture
furniture.catalogHelp: Generic pieces with fixed dimensions. Width × depth × height. Added at a fitting position inside the room.
furniture.help: Select a piece in the plan or list. Move, rotate, duplicate or delete it.
furniture.empty: This project has no furniture yet.
furniture.canvasHelp: Drag furniture to move it; use two fingers to navigate without moving pieces.
furniture.positionHelp: X and Y locate the center of the base from the plan origin. Choose metres or centimetres. Rotation is clockwise. Grid snapping applies when saving if enabled.
furniture.selectedInfo: Center: X {{x}} m · Y {{y}} m · Rotation: {{rotation}}°.
furniture.retryHelp: The proposed change is kept for retry; the saved design is still intact.

errors.numbers: Enter valid coordinates and angle, using a decimal comma or point.
errors.outside: The entire furniture footprint must fit inside the room. Change its position or rotation, or choose a smaller piece.
errors.height: The furniture exceeds the room height. Choose another piece.
errors.invalid: Could not validate the change. Check the piece and room, or reopen the project.

viewer.help: Drag to rotate. Use two fingers to zoom or pan; with a mouse, use the wheel to zoom and right-drag to pan. Cutaway view hides the front walls to reveal the interior.
viewer.keyboard: Arrows: rotate and tilt. W, A, S and D: pan. Plus or minus: zoom. Zero or Home: fit room. T: top view.
viewer.scope: Room, finishes and furniture from the same project. To move, rotate, duplicate or delete a piece, return to the 2D plan; this view reflects your saved changes when reopened.
viewer.unavailable: We could not display 3D on this device.
viewer.recovery: Your project is still intact. Retry or return to the 2D plan.

layout.rectangleHelp: One space with width and depth.
layout.lHelp: One space with a cutout at the bottom-right corner of the plan.
layout.connectedHelp: Two rectangles joined by an open passage, with independent dimensions.
layout.cutHelp: Set the empty cutout at the bottom-right corner. The initial width and depth are the overall L dimensions.
layout.secondHelp: Second space measurements. Edges align at the top or left and the common span stays open.
layout.openHelp: Connected spaces share an open floor-to-ceiling passage, with no door or dividing wall along the common span.
layout.preview: Layout preview; numbers identify each space.
